# SoftwareICO

> SoftwareICO is a curated directory of SaaS products that helps businesses discover software tailored to their industry and problems -- from CRMs and ERPs to AI chatbots and e-commerce integrations.

Product listings are available in English and Bulgarian and include descriptions, pricing, categories, and tags.

## Pages

- [Home](https://softwareico.com/): Landing page with featured products and aggregate stats
- [Product list](https://softwareico.com/products): Browse all products with search, sort, and filtering by category, tags, and pricing
- [About](https://softwareico.com/about): What SoftwareICO is and who it's for
- [Contact](https://softwareico.com/contact): How to get in touch
